# Luxora Boutique Hotel

> A boutique hotel experience in Lodwar, Kenya — just 10 minutes from Lodwar Airport.

Luxora is a boutique hotel offering comfortable rooms, dining, meetings & events, and curated excursions in the Turkana region.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the hotel, rooms, and experiences
- [About](/about): Our story, values, and what makes Luxora unique
- [Rooms](/rooms): Accommodation options including twin and other room types
- [Experiences](/experiences): Featured excursions and activities around Lodwar
- [Meetings & Events](/mice): MICE facilities for conferences and events
- [Blog](/blog): Stories, travel tips, and updates from Luxora
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with our team
- [Reservations](/reservations): Book your stay at Luxora
